entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Shri Raghunandan Soni, Advocate for the appellant.

Shri H.S. Rathore, Public Prosecutor for the respondent Heard on I.A No.11430/2025, which is repeat application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C.
(equivalent to Section 430(1) of BNSS) for grant of suspension of jail sentence filed on behalf of the appellant - Raju @ Rajesh.

The present appellant has been convicted under Sections 376-D of IPC alongiwth Section 3(A)/4 r/w 17 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced to undergo RI for 20 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- and RI for 07 years with fine of Rs.2,000/- respectively with usual default stipulations.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: This repeat application has been filed mainly on the ground that identically placed co-convict Ashique has been granted suspension of jail sentence by the Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 02.09.2022 passed in Cr.A. No.7610/2019.

Upon perusal of the order dated 02.09.2022, this Court finds that case of the present appellant is identical to the case of co-convict Ashique, who has already been extended the benefit of suspension of jail sentence.
Appellant has already remained in custody for more than 08 years.
Counsel for the respondent/State could not point out that case of the 2 CRA-10038-2019 present appellant is different from the case of co-convict Ashique.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the entire facts of the case so also the fact that appellant has remained in jail for more than 08 years and also the ground of parity with co-convict Ashique, we deem it proper to suspend the jail sentence of the appellant.

The jail sentence of appellant - Raju @ Rajesh is suspended upon his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing a bail Raju @ Rakesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 26 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164560661/
1 bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 13.07.2026 and on subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry.

sentences.text: With the aforesaid, IA stands is allowed and stands disposed of.
